data.description: You cast cleric spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability. You know all cleric spells of levels for which you have spell slots and can prepare a number of them equal to your Wisdom modifier + your cleric level each day.
Choose one of two divine callings — Protector or Thaumaturge — that shapes your martial or mystical focus as a cleric.
data.note: SRD 5.2: Choose Protector or Thaumaturge at L1. Player pick stored in character.featureChoices.divine-order.feature.feature; the chosen sub-feature row is loaded by the engine.

data.description: You gain proficiency with Heavy Armor and Martial weapons, allowing you to serve on the front lines as a warrior of your deity.
data.note: SRD 5.2 Protector: Proficiency with Heavy Armor and Martial weapons.

data.description: You learn one additional cleric cantrip and gain proficiency in one of the following skills: Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion.
data.note: SRD 5.2 Thaumaturge: Extra cleric cantrip (pick from SRD cantrips) + proficiency in one of Arcana/History/Nature/Religion. WisMod bonus to the chosen skill cannot be gated on the skill pick — engine limitation; omitted.

data.description: You can channel divine energy to fuel magical effects. You start with Turn Undead and gain additional Channel Divinity options from your subclass. You can use Channel Divinity a number of times per Short Rest that increases as you gain cleric levels.
data.note: Uses per short rest scale with cleric level: 2 at L2, 3 at L6, 4 at L18. Uses perClass cleric table for automatic scaling.

data.description: As an Action, expend a Channel Divinity use to present your holy symbol. Each undead within 30 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or be turned for 1 minute. A turned creature must spend its turns moving away from you and can't willingly move closer.
data.note: Consumes a Channel Divinity use; undead in range make a Wisdom save (spell DC) or are turned for 1 minute. v0 surfaces the save action; the resource accounting lives on the Channel Divinity activity.

data.description: Choose a Divine Domain that defines your sacred calling, granting you domain spells and special abilities at 3rd level and again as you advance.
data.note: Placeholder for Divine Domain selection (Life / Light / Trickery / War in 2024 SRD 5.2). The chosen subclass slug lives on character.classes[].subclass.

data.description: When you use Turn Undead, you can deal Radiant damage to each undead that fails its saving throw. The damage equals your Wisdom modifier times a d8 (minimum 1 die), though this damage doesn't force the creature to move away.
